settings.name: SRI Ventures & Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
settings.seo_title: SRI Ventures & Consulting Pvt. Ltd. | Ventures & Consulting
settings.seo_description: Explore SRI Ventures for farm inputs, agricultural produce and handloom products, and SRI Consulting for business strategy, agribusiness and institutional development.

ventures.title: Farm Inputs
ventures.headline: Quality inputs for productive farming.
ventures.description: Our farm input business connects farmers and agricultural enterprises with the products they need for day-to-day farm management.
items: Animal feed for poultry, pigs, cattle and fish

ventures.title: Farm Outputs
ventures.headline: Bringing farm produce closer to markets.
ventures.description: SRI Ventures connects agricultural producers with consumers and institutional markets through sourcing, promotion, marketing and distribution.

ventures.title: Handloom Products
ventures.headline: Celebrating tradition. Connecting handloom to markets.
ventures.description: India’s handloom heritage carries generations of skill and knowledge. We connect weavers, producer groups and textile businesses with consumer and institutional markets.

consulting.title: Business Strategy & Management
consulting.headline: Turning business challenges into growth opportunities.
consulting.description: We work with entrepreneurs and management teams to assess markets, shape business models and translate a growth strategy into practical operating decisions.
items: Business model development and growth planning
Business plans and Detailed Project Reports

consulting.title: Livestock & Agribusiness
consulting.headline: Building sustainable agricultural and livestock enterprises.
consulting.description: We help agricultural and livestock enterprises develop viable business models, understand their value chains and build market linkages.
items: Poultry, piggery and goatery enterprise development
Livestock value chains and integrated agribusiness models

consulting.title: FPO/FPC & Institutional Development
consulting.headline: From producer collectives to sustainable business institutions.
consulting.description: Farmer Producer Organisations, Farmer Producer Companies and federations need systems that serve their members. Our advisory brings governance, business planning and professional management together.
items: Leadership development, member engagement and ownership

consulting.title: Business Planning & Project Consultancy
consulting.headline: Turning ideas into bankable and implementable projects.
consulting.description: We help organisations assess whether a project is viable, what it will require and how implementation can be monitored.
items: Feasibility studies and Detailed Project Reports

consulting.title: Operations & Management Systems
consulting.headline: Building organisations that perform.
consulting.description: We work with management teams on the operating systems, controls and review routines that support accountable decisions.
items: Quality management, performance monitoring and reporting

consulting.title: Technology & Digital Solutions
consulting.headline: Enabling better decisions through technology.
consulting.description: Technology choices start with the work an organisation needs to do. We assess processes, information needs and the practical requirements for adoption.

consulting.title: Capacity Building & Training
consulting.headline: Developing people. Strengthening organisations.
consulting.description: Training brings enterprise, management and technical skills into the everyday work of entrepreneurs, producer groups and institutions.

/.title: Connecting resources, businesses and opportunities.
/.description: From quality farm inputs and market-ready products to strategic consulting and enterprise development, we connect businesses, farmers and institutions to sustainable opportunities.

/about/.title: About SRI
/about/.description: SRI Ventures & Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is an enterprise-focused organisation working across commercial business operations and professional consulting services.

/know-the-founder/.title: Know the Founder
/know-the-founder/.description: SRI is a founder-led organisation guided by the philosophy of Sustainable Rural Innovations.

/ventures/.title: SRI Ventures
/ventures/.description: SRI Ventures connects farmers, producers, retailers, distributors and institutional buyers through farm inputs, farm produce and handloom products.

/consulting/.title: SRI Consulting
/consulting/.description: SRI Consulting provides strategic advisory, enterprise development and institutional strengthening to businesses, entrepreneurs, producer organisations, federations and development organisations.

/industries/.title: Industries we serve
/industries/.description: Our commercial and advisory work spans agriculture, livestock, handloom and the institutions that connect producers to markets.

/our-approach/.title: Our approach
/our-approach/.description: We work with customers, partners and institutions to understand their needs, identify opportunities, develop appropriate solutions and build sustainable business relationships.

/our-work/.title: Our work
/our-work/.description: Explore approved accounts of SRI’s role, the work undertaken and the outcomes of each assignment.

/insights/.title: Insights & perspectives
/insights/.description: Articles on enterprise development, agriculture, rural institutions and the people building them.

/ventures/products/.description: Browse farm inputs, agricultural produce and handloom products. Contact SRI Ventures for availability, specifications or a quotation.

/partnerships/.title: Partnerships
/partnerships/.description: SRI welcomes collaboration with producers, manufacturers, buyers, institutions, development organisations and technology partners.

/ventures/partnerships/.title: Grow with SRI Ventures
/ventures/partnerships/.description: Explore product distribution, retail partnerships, institutional procurement, farm produce sourcing, handloom sourcing and B2B supply arrangements.

why: We understand both the product and service dimensions of rural enterprises.
Our focus spans agriculture, livestock, agribusiness and institutional development.
We focus on market opportunities, commercial viability and sustainable business models.
Effective systems, organisational capability and accountable management guide our work.
Business growth and positive economic and social outcomes can reinforce one another.
values: Embracing new ideas and practical solutions.
Conducting business with transparency and accountability.
Building long-term economic and social value.
Creating opportunities for businesses, farmers and communities.
Taking responsibility for outcomes and commitments.
